notes.title: Patch 05/05/21
notes.content:
-Main menu theme made significantly quieter
-Proc-spook indicators are quieter
-A short spook-blocker has been implemented to prevent spook spam
-An occasional glitch that causes the spook indicator to play over and over again has been fixed
-Game can now be paused by pressing escape

notes.title: Hotfix 3 : HUD fix
notes.content: Very small update that fixes a HUD that carries over into the main menu upon exiting.

notes.title: Hotfix 2 : Red fade-in and camera shake fix
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where the shampoo would fade to red, rather than black.
-Removed the very fast camera shake effect that would on rare occasions get stuck off center.

notes.title: Hotfix : Xray layer fix
notes.content: Fixes an oversight where a certain spook was not X-rayed and thus not visible to the player.

notes.title: Squeaky Clean is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Squeaky Clean is Live![/h1]

Carrion Wave's first game is now live and ready to play!
[i]It's time to make showers a spooky place to be![/i]

Thanks to everyone who tested the game pre-launch and to all of our supporters over the 7 month development cycle. This simple game turned out more complex than originally anticipated, but it was worth the frustrations!

If you have any questions or concerns please don't hesitate to ask at carrionwave@gmail.com!

[b]Thank you for checking out Squeaky Clean![/b]
